items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 59:1
items.html: Mocha deAvira, which is the second head of Arich Anpin, is called the upper Sealed Brain, or the upper sealed Hochma, as written in Answer 38.
